name: Barbados Blue Water Sports
summary: Barbados Blue is a PADI dive centre at the Hilton on Needham's Point, a short boat ride from the wrecks of Carlisle Bay Marine Park. It runs daily dives and turtle and shipwreck snorkel trips, PADI courses from a first try dive to Divemaster, freediving courses and private charters. Two marine biologists on staff run reef cleanups and coral restoration work.
standouts: The only PADI Freediving Centre on the island
PADI AWARE partner with two marine biologists on staff
Nine shipwrecks within a mile of the dive shop

contact.address: Hilton Hotel Complex, Needham's Point, Pebbles Beach, Carlisle Bay, St. Michael

trips.title: Snorkel Turtle & Shipwreck Safari
trips.summary: A guided snorkel trip five minutes by boat to Carlisle Bay Marine Park, where you swim with green sea turtles and float over shipwrecks from the two world wars. Guides explain the history of the wrecks, and all gear and a snorkel vest are provided.
highlights: 5-minute boat ride to Carlisle Bay Marine Park
Green sea turtles and WWI and WWII shipwrecks
All snorkel gear and vests provided
trips.departsFrom: Barbados Blue dive centre, Hilton Barbados, Needham's Point
includes: Snorkel, mask, fins and lifejacket or snorkel vest
bring: GoPro (camera cases for sale or rent)
trips.requirements: All snorkellers wear a snorkel vest. The morning tour needs a minimum of 4 people. Children as young as 2 have snorkelled with them.
trips.checkNotes: Meet at the dive centre at 9:00am or 1:30pm. Price from the Price List page. Duration not stated. The snorkel page also embeds a Peek booking widget (www.peek.com/s/59c67f61-6557-481c-a58b-42c7dbaf20e4/ZYy0B); not opened.

trips.title: 2 Tank Dive
trips.summary: A morning boat dive trip with two tanks for certified divers, to reefs and wrecks on the west and south coasts. The boat leaves at 9:30am from the dive centre at the Hilton.
highlights: Two dives on reefs and wrecks
trips.departsFrom: Barbados Blue dive centre, Hilton Barbados, Needham's Point
trips.requirements: Certified divers who have dived in the past 12 months. Others are advised to take the free Scuba Refresher first, which means joining the afternoon dive instead.
trips.checkNotes: Meet at the dive centre at 9:00am. Price from the Price List page. Duration not stated. A free Scuba Refresher can be added when booking (meet 11:30am per the Scuba page; the daily schedule lists it at 12:00pm). In summer some dives go to the east coast.

trips.title: 1 Tank Dive
trips.summary: An afternoon single-tank boat dive in Carlisle Bay Marine Park, where several shipwrecks lie close to the dive centre. It suits certified divers and those who have just done a refresher.
highlights: Shipwrecks within a mile of the dive shop
trips.departsFrom: Barbados Blue dive centre, Hilton Barbados, Needham's Point
trips.requirements: Certified divers. Divers who have not dived in the past 12 months are advised to take the free Scuba Refresher.
trips.checkNotes: Meet at the dive centre at 1:30pm. Price from the Price List page; the Marine Park as the site is from the daily schedule. Duration not stated.

trips.summary: Packs of 3 to 10 boat dives for certified divers, used across the morning and afternoon dive trips. Divers bringing their own full set of gear get a further discount.
highlights: Extra discount with full personal gear

trips.title: Discover Scuba Diving, Resort Experience
trips.summary: A first try at scuba with a PADI instructor, with no certification needed. There is no swimming test, and the session starts at noon at the dive centre.
highlights: No experience or swimming test needed
trips.departsFrom: Barbados Blue dive centre, Hilton Barbados, Needham's Point
trips.requirements: Minimum age 10 in the ocean. A PADI medical form must be completed; a YES answer to any question needs a doctor's clearance.
trips.checkNotes: Price from the Price List page; time from the site's daily schedule (Try Scuba for Beginners). Age and swimming details from the FAQs page. Duration not stated.

trips.title: PADI Scuba Diver
trips.summary: A PADI scuba certification offered alongside the full Open Water Diver course. The theory can be done at home through PADI eLearning before you arrive.
trips.departsFrom: Barbados Blue dive centre, Hilton Barbados, Needham's Point
trips.requirements: Water fitness evaluation including a 200m swim and a 10-minute survival float. A PADI medical form must be completed; a YES answer to any question needs a doctor's clearance.
trips.checkNotes: Price from the Price List page. The site does not describe this course beyond the FAQ, which names it next to the Open Water Diver course. Duration not stated.
